newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Inparsa to be vehicle for mobile phone bid.
newsitem.headline: Inparsa to be vehicle for mobile phone bid.

text.p: Inparsa, the Belmiro de Azevedo holding which controls Sonae Industria, will be the vehicle for the group's bid for Portugal's third mobile phone licence, Azevedo told a news conference.
Inparsa will be bidding in alliance with EDP-Electricidade de Portugal, two state-owned gas companies and telecommunications concern Maxitel.
It had already been announced that the Azevedo group would take a majority stake in the consortium, although it was not known which particular company would be the vehicle.

Inparsa stock has soared in recent days on the Lisbon bourse, partly on speculation that it could get the mobile phone business. The bidding for the licence will be formally opened in September. So far the Inparsa-EDP consortium is the only player to declare its hand.

Azevedo said that the consortium was also negotiating with eight possible foreign partners from which one will be chosen. The foreign operator would take a stake of between 10 and 20 percent, he told a news conference.
According to newspaper reports, France Telecom and Teledanmark are amongst the possible partners.
